scenarios.title: A new colleague
scenarios.youRo: Ești Andrei. E prima ta zi într-o echipă nouă. O colegă vine la tine lângă automatul de cafea.

turns.say: Hi! Are you the new developer?
turns.hintRo: Confirmă că ești tu și spune că îți pare bine de cunoștință.
answers: Yes, I am. Nice to meet you.
Yes, that's me. Nice to meet you!
Yes, I'm the new developer. Nice to meet you.

turns.say: Nice to meet you too. I'm Elena, the designer. Where are you from?
turns.sayRo: Încântată și eu. Eu sunt Elena, designerul. De unde ești?
turns.hintRo: Spune că ești din România și întreab-o și pe ea.
answers: I'm from Romania. And you?
I'm from Romania. Where are you from?
I'm from Romania, from Cluj. What about you?

turns.say: I'm from Spain. Oh, do you like coffee?
turns.sayRo: Eu sunt din Spania. A, îți place cafeaua?
turns.hintRo: Spune că da, îți place foarte mult și bei cafea în fiecare dimineață.
answers: Yes, I love coffee!
Yes, I do. I drink coffee every morning.
Oh yes, I love it. Every morning!

turns.say: Me too! Here's a cup for you. How is your first day?
turns.sayRo: Și eu! Poftim o cană pentru tine. Cum e prima ta zi?
turns.hintRo: Spune că e o zi bună și că oamenii de aici sunt foarte drăguți.
answers: It's good, thanks. The team is very nice.
Very good! Everyone is very nice here.
It's great. The people here are really nice.

turns.say: Great. What are you working on today?
turns.hintRo: Spune că lucrezi la un site nou pentru un client.
answers: I'm working on a new website for a client.
A new website for a client.
I'm building a website for a client.

turns.say: Cool! The team has lunch together on Fridays. Can you come?
turns.sayRo: Tare! Echipa ia prânzul împreună vinerea. Poți să vii?
turns.hintRo: Spune că da, poți veni, și mulțumește-i pentru invitație.
answers: Yes, I can. Thank you!
Sure, I can come. Thanks!
Yes, of course I can. Thanks a lot.

scenarios.closing: Great! See you on Friday, then.

scenarios.title: Lunch at a sandwich bar
scenarios.titleRo: Prânzul la un bar cu sandvișuri
scenarios.youRo: Ești în pauza de prânz, la un mic bar cu sandvișuri lângă birou. Vorbești cu vânzătorul.

turns.say: Hi there! What can I get you?
turns.hintRo: Cere un sandviș cu pui, politicos.
answers: A chicken sandwich, please.
I'd like a chicken sandwich, please.
Can I have a chicken sandwich, please?

turns.say: Sure. Do you want cheese in it?
turns.hintRo: Spune că nu, mulțumești, nu-ți place brânza.
answers: No, thanks. I don't like cheese.
No, thank you. I don't really like cheese.
No cheese, please. I don't like it.

turns.say: No problem. Anything to drink?
turns.hintRo: Cere un suc de portocale.
answers: An orange juice, please.
I'd like an orange juice.
Yes, orange juice, please.

turns.say: Is it for here or to go?
turns.hintRo: Spune că e la pachet, pentru că ești foarte ocupat azi.
answers: To go, please. I'm very busy today.
To go, please.
It's to go, thanks. I'm busy today.

turns.say: OK. Here you are. Do you work near here?
turns.hintRo: Spune că da, biroul tău e chiar pe strada asta.
answers: Yes, my office is on this street.
Yes, I work in the office opposite.
Yes, my office is very near here.

turns.say: Nice! Do you pay by card?
turns.hintRo: Spune că da, cu cardul, și mulțumește.
answers: Yes, by card, please.
Card, please. Thank you.
Yes, with my card. Thanks.

scenarios.closing: Thank you! Have a nice day!

scenarios.title: A client needs a website
scenarios.titleRo: Un client are nevoie de un site
scenarios.youRo: Ești Andrei, programator freelance. Te sună un client nou care are un restaurant și vrea un site.

turns.say: Hello, is this Andrei?
turns.hintRo: Confirmă că ești tu și întreabă cum îl poți ajuta.
answers: Yes, speaking. How can I help you?
Yes, it's me. How can I help?
Hello, yes. How can I help you?

turns.say: Hi, I'm Tom Brown. I've got a small restaurant, and I need a website.
turns.sayRo: Bună, sunt Tom Brown. Am un restaurant mic și am nevoie de un site.
turns.hintRo: Spune că e grozav și că poți să-i faci un site.
answers: Great! I can build a website for your restaurant.
No problem. I can make a nice website for you.
That's great. I can build a website for you.

turns.say: Good. Can you make it in English and Romanian?
turns.sayRo: Bine. Îl poți face în engleză și în română?
turns.hintRo: Spune că da, poți, nicio problemă.
answers: Yes, I can. No problem.
Of course I can.
Sure, I can do that.

turns.say: And can people see the menu on their phones?
turns.sayRo: Și oamenii pot vedea meniul pe telefon?
turns.hintRo: Spune că da, pot, site-ul merge bine și pe telefoane.
answers: Yes, of course. The website is good on phones too.
Yes, they can. It works on mobile phones too.
Yes, they can see it on their phones.

turns.say: Perfect. Are you free for a meeting this week?
turns.sayRo: Perfect. Ești liber pentru o întâlnire săptămâna aceasta?
turns.hintRo: Spune că da, ești liber joi după-amiază.
answers: Yes, I'm free on Thursday afternoon.
Yes. Is Thursday afternoon OK for you?
Thursday afternoon is good for me.

turns.say: Thursday is fine. Can you send me an email with the details?
turns.sayRo: Joi e bine. Îmi poți trimite un e-mail cu detaliile?
turns.hintRo: Spune că da, poți să-l trimiți azi.
answers: Yes, of course. I can send it today.
Sure, I can send you an email today.
No problem. I can send it this afternoon.

scenarios.title: Your work day
scenarios.youRo: Începi să lucrezi cu o firmă nouă. Managera de proiect vrea să știe cum arată o zi obișnuită de lucru pentru tine.

turns.say: So, Andrei, when do you start work?
turns.hintRo: Spune că de obicei începi devreme, dimineața.
answers: I usually start early in the morning.
I start work early, in the morning.
Early. I always start in the morning.

turns.say: Do you check your emails every day?
turns.sayRo: Îți verifici e-mailurile în fiecare zi?
turns.hintRo: Spune că da, le verifici în fiecare dimineață.
answers: Yes, I check my emails every morning.
Yes, I do. Every morning.
Yes, every day, in the morning.

turns.say: Good. Do you work at home or in an office?
turns.sayRo: Bine. Lucrezi acasă sau la birou?
turns.hintRo: Spune că lucrezi de obicei acasă, dar uneori într-o cafenea.
answers: I usually work at home, but sometimes in a café.
At home. Sometimes I work in a café.
I work at home, and sometimes in a café.

turns.say: Do you often have meetings with clients?
turns.hintRo: Spune că da, des, de obicei pe apel video.
answers: Yes, often. Usually on a video call.
Yes, I often have video calls with clients.
Yes, quite often, on video calls.

turns.say: And when do you finish work?
turns.hintRo: Spune că termini de obicei seara, dar niciodată foarte târziu.
answers: I usually finish in the evening.
In the evening, but never very late.
I finish in the evening. Never very late.

turns.say: What do you do after work?
turns.hintRo: Spune că mergi des la sală și uneori te plimbi cu bicicleta.
answers: I often go to the gym or I ride my bike.
I go to the gym. Sometimes I ride my bike.
I usually go to the gym after work.

scenarios.title: A tourist asks for help
scenarios.youRo: Ești în centrul orașului tău. O turistă te oprește pe stradă și te întreabă unde găsește câteva locuri.

turns.say: Excuse me, do you speak English?
turns.hintRo: Spune că da, puțin, și întreab-o dacă o poți ajuta.
answers: Yes, a little. Can I help you?
Yes, I do. How can I help?
Yes, a bit. Can I help?

turns.say: Thank you! Is there a bank near here?
turns.sayRo: Mulțumesc! Este vreo bancă pe aproape?
turns.hintRo: Spune că da, este o bancă lângă parc.
answers: Yes, there's a bank next to the park.
Yes, there is. It's near the park.
Yes, there's one opposite the park.

turns.say: Great. And is there a supermarket on this street?
turns.sayRo: Super. Și este vreun supermarket pe strada aceasta?
turns.hintRo: Spune că nu pe strada asta, dar este unul lângă gară.
answers: No, there isn't. But there's one near the train station.
Not on this street, but there's one near the train station.
No, sorry. There's one next to the train station.

turns.say: Is the train station far?
turns.hintRo: Spune că nu, e aproape și poate merge pe jos.
answers: No, it isn't. You can walk there.
No, it's near. You can walk.
Not really. You can walk there.

turns.say: Can I take a bus too?
turns.hintRo: Spune că da, stația de autobuz e chiar acolo.
answers: Yes, you can. The bus stop is over there.
Sure. There's a bus stop over there.
Yes, the bus stop is right there.

turns.say: Thank you so much! Are you from here?
turns.hintRo: Spune că da, locuiești aici și îți place mult orașul.
answers: Yes, I live here. I love this city.
Yes, I am. I really like this city.
Yes. I live here and I love it.

scenarios.title: A video call with a teammate
scenarios.titleRo: Un apel video cu un coleg
scenarios.youRo: Ai un apel video cu un coleg dintr-o altă echipă. Vreți să vă uitați împreună la o problemă din aplicație.

turns.say: Hi Andrei! Can you hear me?
turns.hintRo: Spune că îl auzi, dar nu-l vezi.
answers: Yes, I can hear you, but I can't see you.
I can hear you, but I can't see you.
Yes, I can hear you. But your camera is off.

turns.say: Oh, sorry. Can you see me now?
turns.hintRo: Spune că da, acum îl vezi.
answers: Yes, I can see you now.
Yes, now I can see you.
Yes, that's better. I can see you.

turns.say: Good. What are you doing right now?
turns.hintRo: Spune că verifici aplicația și repari un bug.
answers: I'm checking the app. I'm fixing a bug.
I'm fixing a bug in the app right now.
I'm working on a bug in the app.

turns.say: Can you share your screen?
turns.hintRo: Spune că da, sigur, și roagă-l să aștepte un moment.
answers: Sure, just a moment.
Yes, of course. Wait a moment.
OK, just a moment, please.

turns.say: I can see it now. Wait, I can't hear you. You're on mute!
turns.sayRo: Acum îl văd. Stai, nu te aud. Ai microfonul oprit!
turns.hintRo: Cere-ți scuze și întreabă-l dacă acum te aude.
answers: Sorry! Can you hear me now?
Oh, sorry about that. Can you hear me now?
Sorry! Is it OK now? Can you hear me?

turns.say: Yes, that's fine. So where is the problem?
turns.sayRo: Da, e în regulă. Deci, unde e problema?
turns.hintRo: Spune că problema e pe pagina de login: butonul nu merge.
answers: It's on the login page. The button doesn't work.
The problem is on the login page. This button doesn't work.
Look, it's the login button. It doesn't work.

scenarios.closing: Ah, I see it. Let's fix it together!

scenarios.title: Tell me about your team
scenarios.youRo: O clientă nouă vrea să afle mai multe despre tine și despre echipa ta înainte să înceapă proiectul.

turns.say: So, do you work alone?
turns.hintRo: Spune că nu, ai o echipă mică.
answers: No, I've got a small team.
No, I don't. I have a small team.
Not really. I work with a small team.

turns.say: Nice! Who is in your team?
turns.sayRo: Frumos! Cine e în echipa ta?
turns.hintRo: Spune că e un designer și încă o programatoare.
answers: There's a designer and another developer.
A designer and a developer. They're very good.
I work with a designer and another developer.

turns.say: Great. Where are they from?
turns.hintRo: Spune că sunt și ei din România, ca tine.
answers: They're from Romania too.
They're from Romania, like me.
Both of them are from Romania.

turns.say: Is your designer good?
turns.hintRo: Spune că da, e foarte bun și foarte rapid.
answers: Yes, he's very good and very fast.
Yes, he's very good. And he's fast!
Oh yes, very good. His designs are beautiful.

turns.say: And have you got a boss?
turns.hintRo: Spune că nu, ești freelancer, deci tu ești șeful.
answers: No, I haven't. I'm a freelancer.
No, I'm a freelancer. I'm the boss!
No. I'm a freelancer, so I'm my own boss.

turns.say: Ha ha, lucky you! Have you got a family?
turns.sayRo: Ha ha, ce noroc! Ai familie?
turns.hintRo: Spune că da, ai o soție și o fiică.
answers: Yes, I've got a wife and a daughter.
Yes, I have a wife and a little daughter.
Yes. My wife and my daughter. They're great.

scenarios.closing: Lovely! OK, let's talk about the project.

scenarios.title: How was your weekend?
scenarios.youRo: E luni dimineață la birou. O colegă te întreabă cum a fost weekendul tău la mare.

turns.say: Good morning! How was your weekend?
turns.sayRo: Bună dimineața! Cum a fost weekendul?
turns.hintRo: Spune că a fost foarte frumos și mulțumește.
answers: It was great, thanks!
It was very good, thanks.
Oh, it was really nice, thanks.

turns.say: Were you at home?
turns.hintRo: Spune că nu, ai fost la mare cu familia.
answers: No, I wasn't. I was at the beach with my family.
No, we were at the beach.
No. My family and I were at the beach.

turns.say: Oh, nice! Was the weather good?
turns.sayRo: Ce frumos! A fost vreme bună?
turns.hintRo: Spune că da, a fost soare și foarte cald.
answers: Yes, it was sunny and very hot.
Yes, very sunny and hot.
Yes! It was hot and sunny every day.

turns.say: Were you in a hotel?
turns.hintRo: Spune că da, ați stat într-un hotel mic.
answers: Yes, we stayed in a small hotel.
Yes, a small hotel near the beach.
Yes, we stayed in a nice little hotel.

turns.say: Lovely. Are you tired today?
turns.hintRo: Spune că da, puțin, pentru că ați ajuns acasă târziu.
answers: Yes, a little. We arrived home very late.
A bit. We arrived late last night.
Yes, I'm tired. We arrived home late.

turns.say: Oh no! Do you want a coffee?
turns.hintRo: Spune că da, te rog – chiar ai nevoie de o cafea.
answers: Yes, please! I really need a coffee.
Oh yes, please. Thank you!
Yes, please. A big coffee!

items.ro: Echipa mea e mică, dar foarte bună.

items.en: I'd like to check in, please.
items.ro: Aș vrea să mă cazez, vă rog.

items.en: Where can I find a taxi?

items.ro: Zborul meu a întârziat foarte mult.

questions.sample: My name is Andrei, and I'm a freelance developer from Cluj.
I'm from Romania. I live in Cluj. It's a big city with a lot of students.
I'm a freelance developer. I build websites and apps for small companies.
Yes, I've got a wife and a daughter. We've got a cat too.
There's a laptop, a big screen, a keyboard and a cup of coffee.

questions.q: What do you usually do in the morning?
questions.sample: I get up early, have breakfast and check my emails. Then I start work.
I love pizza and chicken soup, but I don't like fish very much.
I can build websites and fix bugs. I can also cook and swim, but I can't sing.

questions.q: What do you do at the weekend?
questions.sample: I often go to the park with my family. Sometimes I play football with my friends.

questions.q: Is there a nice café near your home?
questions.qRo: Este o cafenea drăguță lângă casa ta?
questions.sample: Yes, there is. There's a small café opposite my flat, and the coffee is great.

questions.q: What are you doing right now?
questions.sample: Right now I'm learning English. I'm sitting at my desk and drinking a coffee.

questions.q: Where were you on your last holiday?
questions.qRo: Unde ai fost în ultima vacanță?
questions.sample: Last summer I was in Greece with my family. We stayed in a small hotel near the beach.
